name: @moysklad/contracts
//exports: SOURCE-ONLY package — `exports` points at ./src, there is NO build step and NO dist/. Rationale: @moysklad/money ships a dist and a stale .tsbuildinfo once produced a green typecheck with a runtime 'X is not a function' (memory: money-dist-stale-tsbuildinfo). Contracts are pure Zod + types with no heavy runtime, so shipping source removes that failure mode entirely: tsc reads the .ts as its own declaration file, vitest/vite transpile it on the fly, and web imports the types with `import type` so nothing reaches the bundle.
